title: Check ray tracing and higher-fidelity lighting options
objective: Determine whether this SPEAR checkout currently enables hardware ray tracing for the flashlight/cafeteria workflows, and identify practical options to improve lighting/render fidelity for realistic active-illumination testing without changing code.
instructions: Inspect repo project/config files, example scripts, docs, and recent Tower state for ray tracing, Lumen, reflection, exposure, shadow, and rendering-quality settings.
Focus on current behavior for examples/flashlight/run.py with --live-lighting-mode realistic and cafeteria_500sqft_v2.
Clearly distinguish what is currently enabled by code/config from what is only a possible Unreal setting.
If you need external Unreal Engine facts, use only stable/official Unreal documentation or local engine docs if available; avoid broad web speculation.

Return a concise answer suitable for the user: do we have ray tracing on, what likely renderer path are we using, what fidelity improvements are most valuable, and which ones require GPU/project/plugin/package support.
constraints: Do not run Unreal or long processes.
expected_outputs: ResultPacket with findings and recommended fidelity options/commands/settings.
definition_of_done: Tower can answer whether ray tracing is on and provide prioritized fidelity improvements.
